page.overview:
Who is Desandre Alraed?

She is willowy, with brown hair and large brown eyes. She wears her Great Serpent ring on her right hand.

Desandre is strong in the One Power, with a strength level of . She is the strongest among the fifty-one Aes Sedai captured at the Black Tower, with only Lemai being as strong.

Assuming she enrolled between the age of 14 and 18, the earliest she could have been born was 947 NE and latest was 958 NE.

She spent six years as novice and seven as Accepted.
